related.overviewEn: Extend Chemical mechanical planarization by comparing CMP slurry and abrasive control and Copper dual-damascene interconnects: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: CMP 的去除率與刮傷需同時追查磨粒族群、化學活性及墊面接觸。
related.transferEn: CMP removal and scratching require joint analysis of abrasive populations, chemistry and pad contact.
related.difference: 平坦化課看晶圓高度與膜厚分布；漿料課看粒徑尾端、濃度及老化。單靠平均粒徑不能預測整片平坦度。

practice: 畫出漿料批次到膜厚與刮傷的因果假說。

設計固定墊況的分批試驗，保留空白取樣。
practiceEn: Map hypotheses from slurry lots to thickness and scratches.
Compare large-particle tails and useful abrasive concentration before and after filtering.
Design a split with fixed pad condition and sampling blanks.

related.transfer: 雙鑲嵌填銅後須去除表面多餘金屬；CMP 的凹陷與侵蝕會改變互連截面。
related.transferEn: After damascene copper fill, CMP removes overburden; dishing and erosion alter interconnect cross-sections.
related.difference: 填銅重點是孔槽覆蓋與空洞；CMP 重點是選擇性去除與終點。拋光不能修復已埋入的填孔空洞。
related.differenceEn: Fill targets feature coverage and voids; CMP targets selective removal and endpoint. Polishing cannot repair buried fill voids.
practice: 依序畫溝槽、填銅與去除過厚層。
比較相同線寬但不同凹陷的有效截面。
將空洞與凹陷分配到不同量測及改善模組。
practiceEn: Draw trenches, copper fill and overburden removal in order.
Compare effective areas at equal linewidth but different dishing.
Assign voids and dishing to different measurements and corrective modules.

related.overviewEn: Extend Interconnect electromigration reliability by comparing Copper dual-damascene interconnects and Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 互連線與通孔幾何決定局部電流密度；材料、介面與熱路徑共同影響電遷移。
related.transferEn: Line/via geometry sets local current density; materials, interfaces and thermal paths jointly affect electromigration.
related.difference: 雙鑲嵌製程建立導線；電遷移課分析通電老化。室溫導通良好不代表長期電流應力合格。
related.differenceEn: Damascene creates conductors; electromigration studies powered aging. Initial continuity does not establish lifetime under current stress.
practice: 用假設截面計算相同電流下的 J。
畫通孔轉角擁擠與可能熱點。
列出電阻漂移與截面影像的交叉證據。
practiceEn: Calculate J for equal current through hypothetical cross-sections.
Draw via-corner crowding and possible hotspots.
List cross-evidence from resistance drift and cross-sectional images.

related.transfer: 兩者都需要失效定義、加速模型、截尾樣本與機制一致性，不能只報最長存活時間。
related.transferEn: Both require failure criteria, acceleration models, censoring and mechanism consistency, not merely the longest survival time.
related.difference: 電遷移是導體原子輸運與空洞；TDDB 是介電層耗損及導通路徑形成。電流與電場加速參數不能交換。
related.differenceEn: Electromigration concerns atomic transport and voiding; TDDB concerns dielectric wear-out and conductive paths. Current and field acceleration parameters are not interchangeable.
practice: 對同一批假設資料標出失效及右截尾。
分開 J、電場及實際試件溫度。
比較模型在測試區與使用區的外推差異。
practiceEn: Label failures and right-censored observations in hypothetical data.
Separate current density, electric field and specimen temperature.
Compare model extrapolation inside stress and use regimes.

related.overviewEn: Extend Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement by comparing High-k atomic layer deposition and Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 高介電膜的厚度、介面層與局部場分布會影響漏電及可靠度，需聯合結構與電性證據。
related.transferEn: High-k thickness, interfaces and local fields affect leakage and reliability, requiring structural and electrical evidence.
related.difference: ALD 課著重成膜均勻與反應控制；TDDB 課著重隨時間的耗損統計。良好平均膜厚不是壽命保證。
related.differenceEn: ALD targets film uniformity and reaction control; TDDB targets time-dependent wear statistics. Good mean thickness is no lifetime guarantee.
practice: 畫多層介質並比較各層電場。
區分初始漏電、早期缺陷及長時耗損。
指定厚度分布與崩潰統計的共同驗收證據。
practiceEn: Draw a dielectric stack and compare layer fields.
Separate initial leakage, early defects and long-term wear.
Specify joint evidence from thickness distributions and breakdown statistics.

related.transfer: 鐵電電容也要檢查漏電、循環耐久與擊穿；功能切換與材料損傷需要不同量測定義。
related.transferEn: Ferroelectric capacitors also require leakage, cycling endurance and breakdown checks; switching and damage need distinct measurements.
related.difference: 鐵電記憶利用可逆極化；TDDB 研究不可逆耗損。遲滯曲線出現不等於排除了導電假象或老化。
related.differenceEn: Ferroelectric memory uses reversible polarization; TDDB studies irreversible wear. Hysteresis alone does not exclude conduction artifacts or aging.
practice: 分開極化切換、漏電與崩潰電流曲線。
列出循環次數與持續偏壓時間兩種應力。
檢查保持、耐久及擊穿是否各有判準。
practiceEn: Separate polarization switching, leakage and breakdown traces.
List cycling count and continuous-bias duration as different stresses.
Check for separate criteria for retention, endurance and breakdown.

related.overviewEn: Extend DRAM capacitor fabrication by comparing High-aspect-ratio dielectric etching and Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: DRAM 高柱電容與深孔蝕刻都須控制孔口、底部及側壁形貌，孔口尺寸不足以判斷整體品質。
related.transferEn: Tall DRAM capacitors and deep etching require opening, bottom and sidewall control; opening CD alone is insufficient.
related.difference: 蝕刻形成空間；電容整合還需連續電極、高介電覆蓋及機械支撐。深孔合格不等於儲存功能合格。
related.differenceEn: Etching creates space; capacitor integration additionally needs continuous electrodes, dielectric coverage and support. A good hole does not prove memory function.
practice: 標記上中下三段孔徑與側壁。
比較入口與底部電極／介電層覆蓋。
把形貌、電容、漏電與倒塌風險放入同表。
practiceEn: Mark top, middle and bottom widths and sidewalls.
Compare electrode and dielectric coverage at entrance and bottom.
Tabulate profile, capacitance, leakage and collapse risk together.

related.transfer: 儲存電容增加 C 的同時必須守住漏電與介電層壽命；較薄膜不能只看電容收益。
related.transferEn: Increasing storage capacitance must preserve leakage and dielectric lifetime; thinning cannot be judged by capacitance alone.
related.difference: DRAM 保持時間關乎可接受電荷流失與刷新；TDDB 關乎耗損到失效的時間分布。兩種時間不是同一指標。
related.differenceEn: DRAM retention concerns allowable charge loss and refresh; TDDB concerns time-to-failure distributions. They are different time metrics.
practice: 用假設 Q=CV 與漏電估計電荷損失時間。
分開刷新需求與擊穿壽命資料。
檢查平均值相同但尾端不同的兩批電容。
practiceEn: Estimate charge-loss time from hypothetical Q=CV and leakage.
Separate refresh requirements from breakdown-life data.
Compare capacitor lots with equal means but different tails.

related.transfer: 3D NAND 通道穿過多層堆疊，與高深寬比蝕刻共用深度、傾斜、縮頸及底部可達性問題。
related.transferEn: 3D NAND channels traverse multilayers, sharing depth, tilt, necking and bottom-access challenges with high-aspect-ratio etching.
related.difference: 蝕刻輪廓是製程輸出之一；NAND 還須檢查各層記憶單元及選擇閘。孔深達標不能推定每層電性一致。
related.differenceEn: Etch profile is one process output; NAND also needs per-layer cells and select gates. Correct depth does not establish uniform electrical behavior.
practice: 畫通道沿高度的寬度變化。
對齊頂部／中部／底部形貌與電性群組。
區分層數、通道高度與每單元位元數。
practiceEn: Plot channel width along stack height.
Align top/middle/bottom profiles with electrical groups.
Distinguish layer count, channel height and bits per cell.

related.transfer: 垂直 NAND 的每層單元可利用電荷捕捉堆疊改變閾值，結構幾何與電荷保持共同決定窗口。
related.transferEn: Each vertical NAND cell can use a charge-trap stack to shift threshold; geometry and retention jointly determine the window.
related.difference: 垂直堆疊課研究字串、層間一致性及整合；閘極課研究捕捉、穿隧與阻擋層。層數增加不自動改善單元保持。
related.differenceEn: Stacking studies strings, layer uniformity and integration; gate engineering studies trapping, tunneling and blocking layers. More layers do not inherently improve retention.
practice: 將穿隧／捕捉／阻擋層放進一個垂直單元。
比較層位置造成的閾值分布差異。
分開相鄰單元干擾與單層漏電假說。
practiceEn: Place tunnel, trap and blocking layers in one vertical cell.
Compare threshold distributions by layer position.
Separate neighboring-cell interference from single-layer leakage hypotheses.

Compare observables for retention drift and cycling degradation.
Propose measurements distinguishing trapping from ferroelectric switching.

related.differenceEn: Conventional CMOS imaging accumulates charge; SPAD pixels detect discrete avalanches with dead time. Full-well capacity and maximum count rate are different metrics.

related.differenceEn: Imaging qualification concerns response, saturation and noise; ellipsometry measures polarization change. A good film fit cannot alone prove pixel function.

practice: 比較不同循環數的假設厚度資料與截距。

Include a possible interface layer in the model.
Use multiple angles and independent standards to assess thickness intervals.
